verdict.rationale: pnpm is a CLI with a dedicated continuous-integration docs page. In CI it automatically switches to frozen-lockfile mode and fails if the lockfile needs an update. It ships as a self-contained executable that needs no Node.js, and it auto-switches to the version pinned in packageManager. Offline (store-only), dry-run, and devDependency-skipping install options support automated runs, and community users report it is fast in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: no evidence of machine-readable/JSON output or explicit non-interactive flags for agent-driven automation.
